units.Esther 1:1d: This was his dream: Look! Voices and tumult, thunders and an earthquake, disturbance upon the earth!
units.Esther 1:1g: Look! A day of darkness and gloom, affliction and distress, suffering and great disturbance upon the earth!
units.Esther 4:17a: and he implored the Lord, remembering all the Lord’s works, and said:
units.Esther 4:17p: and to open the mouth of nations to praise worthless things, and that a king of flesh might be admired for ever.
units.Esther 4:17t: But rescue us by Thy hand, and help me, who am alone and have no one except Thee, Lord.
units.Esther 8:12d: They not only abolish gratitude among people, but, lifted up by the boasts of those unacquainted with goodness, they suppose they will escape the evil-hating justice of God, Who always watches over all things.
units.Joel 2:1: Blow a trumpet in Zion! Proclaim on My holy mountain, and let all who inhabit the land be thrown into turmoil, because the Lord’s day is present; it is near,
units.Joel 2:2: a day of darkness and gloom, a day of cloud and mist. Like dawn a numerous and strong people will be poured over the mountains. Its like has never existed, nor will another follow it through the years, for generations upon generations.
units.Joel 2:3: Before it is consuming fire, and behind it a kindled flame. The land before its face is like a garden of delight, and behind it a desolate plain; no one will escape it.
units.Zephaniah 1:14: For the Lord’s great day is near, near and very swift. The sound of the Lord’s day is bitter and harsh; it is appointed mighty.
units.Zephaniah 1:15: That day is a day of wrath, a day of affliction and constraint, a day of untimely ruin and destruction, a day of darkness and gloom, a day of cloud and mist,
units.Zephaniah 1:16: a day of trumpet and shouting against fortified cities and high corners.
units.Zephaniah 1:17: I will press people hard, and they will walk like the blind because they sinned against the Lord. He will pour out their blood like dust and their flesh like dung.
units.Zephaniah 1:18: Their silver and gold will certainly not rescue them on the day of the Lord’s wrath. In the fire of His jealousy all the earth will be consumed, for He will bring completion and haste upon all the earth’s inhabitants.
units.Esther 4:17b: “Lord, Lord, King who dost rule over all, everything is under Thine authority, and no one can oppose Thee when Thou wishest to save Israel.
units.Esther 4:17c: For Thou madest heaven and earth and every wonderful thing beneath heaven. Thou art Lord of all, and no one can stand against Thee, the Lord.
units.Esther 4:17d: Thou knowest all things. Thou knowest, Lord, that it was not in insolence, arrogance, or love of glory that I did this, refusing to bow before arrogant Haman. For I would gladly have kissed the soles of his feet for Israel’s salvation.
units.Esther 4:17e: But I did this so that I would not set a human being’s glory above God’s glory. I will bow to no one except Thee, my Lord, and I will not do these things in arrogance.
units.Esther 4:17f: Now, Lord God, King, God of Abraham, spare Thy people, for they look upon us to destroy us and have desired to destroy Thine inheritance from the beginning.
units.Esther 4:17g: Do not overlook Thy portion, which Thou didst redeem for Thyself from the land of Egypt.
units.Esther 4:17h: Hear my supplication, be gracious to Thine allotted people, and turn our mourning into feasting, so that while living we may sing hymns to Thy name, Lord. Do not wipe out the mouth of those who praise Thee.”
units.Psalms 76:2: With my voice I cried to the Lord, with my voice to God, and He attended to me.
units.Psalms 76:3: In the day of my affliction I sought God, with my hands at night before Him, and I was not deceived; my soul refused to be comforted.
units.Psalms 76:4: I remembered God and was glad; I spoke at length, and my spirit lost heart. Diapsalma.
units.Psalms 76:5: My eyes anticipated the watches; I was troubled and did not speak.
units.Psalms 76:6: I considered ancient days, and remembered everlasting years and meditated.
units.Psalms 76:7: At night I spoke at length with my heart, and my spirit kept searching.
units.Psalms 76:8: “Will the Lord reject for the ages, and not again take pleasure?
units.Psalms 76:9: Or will He cut off His mercy to the end, from generation to generation?
units.Psalms 76:10: Or will God forget to show pity, or hold His compassions shut in His wrath?” Diapsalma.
units.Psalms 76:11: And I said, “Now I have begun; this is the change of the Most High’s right hand.”
units.Psalms 76:12: I remembered the Lord’s works, for I will remember Thy wonders from the beginning,
units.Psalms 76:13: and meditate on all Thy works, and speak at length about Thy practices.
units.Psalms 76:14: God, Thy way is in the Holy One; what god is great like our God?
units.Psalms 76:15: Thou art the God who does wonders; Thou madest Thy power known among the peoples.
units.Psalms 76:16: With Thine arm Thou didst redeem Thy people, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Diapsalma.
units.Esther 1:1: In the second year of the reign of Artaxerxes the Great, on the first of Nisa, Mordecai son of Jair, son of Shimei, son of Kish, of the tribe of Benjamin, saw a dream.
units.Esther 1:1b: He was a Jewish man living in the city of Susa, a great man serving in the king’s court.
units.Esther 1:1c: He was among the captives whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had taken captive from Jerusalem with Jeconiah king of Judea.
units.Esther 1:1e: Look! Two great dragons came forward, both ready to wrestle, and their cry became loud.
units.Esther 1:1f: At their cry every nation prepared for war, to wage war against a nation of righteous people.
units.Esther 1:1h: The whole righteous nation was troubled, fearing its own calamities. They prepared to perish and cried out to God.
units.Esther 1:1i: From their cry there came, as though from a small spring, a great river, much water.
units.Esther 1:1k: Light and the sun rose, and the lowly were exalted and devoured the glorious.
units.Esther 1:1l: When Mordecai awoke, having seen this dream and what God had resolved to do, he kept it in his heart and sought in every way to understand it until night.
units.Esther 4:17k: Queen Esther took refuge in the Lord, gripped by mortal anguish. She took off her glorious garments and put on garments of distress and mourning. Instead of splendid perfumes she filled her head with ashes and dung, greatly humbled her body, and filled every place of her joyful adornment with her tangled hair. She implored the Lord God of Israel and said:
units.Esther 4:17l: “My Lord, our King, Thou art the only one. Help me, who am alone and have no helper except Thee, for my danger is at hand.
units.Esther 4:17m: From my birth I have heard within my ancestral tribe that Thou, Lord, didst take Israel from all the nations and our fathers from all their ancestors as an everlasting inheritance, and do for them everything Thou saidst.
units.Esther 4:17n: Now we have sinned before Thee, and Thou hast handed us over to our enemies because we glorified their gods. Thou art righteous, Lord.
units.Esther 4:17o: Now they are not satisfied with the bitterness of our slavery, but have placed their hands upon the hands of their idols, to abolish the decree of Thy mouth, wipe out Thine inheritance, close the mouth of those who praise Thee, and extinguish the glory of Thy house and Thine altar,
units.Esther 4:17q: Do not hand over Thy sceptre, Lord, to those who do not exist. Do not let them mock us at our downfall, but turn their plan back upon them, and make an example of the one who began this against us.
units.Esther 4:17r: Remember, Lord; make Thyself known in the time of our affliction. Give me courage, King of the gods, who dost hold sway over every dominion.
units.Esther 4:17s: Put well-ordered speech in my mouth before the lion, and turn his heart to hatred of the one who wages war against us, to bring him and those of one mind with him to an end.
units.Esther 4:17u: Thou hast knowledge of all things, and Thou knowest that I have hated the glory of the lawless and abhor the bed of the uncircumcised and of every foreigner.
units.Esther 4:17w: Thou knowest my necessity: I abhor the sign of my exalted position upon my head on the days when I appear. I abhor it like a menstrual cloth, and I do not wear it in my days of quiet.
units.Esther 4:17x: Thy slave woman has not eaten at Haman’s table; I have not honored the king’s drinking feast or drunk wine of libations.
units.Esther 4:17y: Thy slave woman has had no joy from the day of my change until now except in Thee, Lord, God of Abraham.
units.Esther 4:17z: God who is mighty over all, hear the voice of those who have lost hope, and rescue us from the hand of evildoers. Rescue me from my fear.”
units.Acts 12:20: Herod was fiercely hostile toward the people of Tyre and Sidon. They came to him with one accord and, after winning over Blastus, the king’s chamberlain, asked for peace, because their country received its food from the king’s territory.
units.Acts 12:21: On an appointed day Herod put on royal clothing, sat on the tribunal, and delivered an address to them.
units.Acts 12:22: The populace shouted, “A god’s voice, and not a human being’s!”
units.Acts 12:23: Immediately an angel of the Lord struck him because he did not give the glory to God. He was eaten by worms and breathed his last.
units.Psalms 24:15: My eyes are continually toward the Lord, for He will pull my feet out of a trap.
units.Psalms 24:16: Look upon me and have mercy on me, for I am alone and poor.
units.Psalms 24:17: The afflictions of my heart widened; bring me out of my distresses.
units.Psalms 24:18: See my humiliation and my toil, and forgive all my sins.
units.Psalms 24:19: See my enemies, for they multiplied and hated me with unjust hatred.
units.Psalms 24:20: Guard my soul and rescue me; may I not be put to shame, for I hoped in Thee.
units.Psalms 24:21: Innocent and upright people clung to me, for I waited for Thee, Lord.
units.Psalms 24:22: Redeem Israel, God, from all its afflictions.
units.Esther 8:12b: “The great King Artaxerxes, to the rulers of the regions in the one hundred twenty-seven satrapies from India to Ethiopia, and to those who are loyal to us: greetings.
units.Esther 8:12c: “Many, repeatedly honored by the abundant kindness of their benefactors, have become arrogant. They not only seek to harm those subject to us, but, unable to bear such abundance, they also attempt to plot against their own benefactors.
units.Esther 8:12e: Often the persuasion of friends entrusted with managing affairs has made many appointed to authority complicit in innocent bloodshed and has surrounded them with irreparable calamities,
units.Esther 8:12f: as these men have deceived the rulers’ innocent good intentions with their malicious false reasoning.
units.Esther 8:12g: You can examine this, not so much from the older accounts we have handed down, as by investigating what has been impiously carried out close at hand through the pestilence of those who wield power unworthily.
units.Esther 8:12h: You can also attend to what comes afterward, so that we may provide an undisturbed kingdom for all people in peace,
units.Psalms 93:3: How long, Lord, will sinners— how long will sinners boast,
units.Psalms 93:4: utter and speak injustice— will all who work lawlessness speak?
units.Psalms 93:5: They humbled Thy people, Lord, and mistreated Thine inheritance.
units.Psalms 93:6: They killed the widow and newcomer and murdered orphans.
units.Psalms 93:7: They said, The Lord will not see, nor will the God of Jacob understand.
units.Psalms 93:8: Understand now, you senseless among the people; and you fools, become wise at last.
units.Psalms 93:9: Does the One who planted the ear not hear, or the One who formed the eye not perceive?
units.Psalms 93:10: Will the One who disciplines nations not rebuke— the One who teaches humankind knowledge?
units.Psalms 93:11: The Lord knows human reasonings, that they are futile.
units.Sirach 16:17: Do not say, “I will be hidden from the Lord; who will remember me from on high? Among a numerous people I will certainly not be known, for what is my soul in the immeasurable creation?”
units.Sirach 16:18: Behold, heaven and the heaven of heaven, the abyss and the earth will be shaken at His visitation.
units.Sirach 16:19: Together the mountains and the foundations of the earth are shaken with trembling when He looks upon them.
units.Sirach 16:20: Yet no heart will consider these things, and who will ponder His ways?
units.Sirach 16:21: There is also a tempest that a person will not see, and most of His works are hidden.
units.Sirach 16:22: Who will announce works of righteousness? Who will wait? For the covenant is far away.
units.Sirach 16:23: Someone deficient in heart thinks these things; a foolish and wandering man thinks foolish things.
units.Isaiah 29:5: The wealth of the ungodly will be like dust from a wheel, like drifting chaff, and it will be like a moment, immediately,
units.Isaiah 29:6: from the Lord Sabaoth. For there will be a visitation with thunder, earthquake and a great sound, a rushing storm and a consuming flame of fire.
units.Isaiah 29:7: Like someone dreaming in sleep will be the wealth of all nations who marched against Ariel, all who marched against Jerusalem, and all assembled against her and afflicting her.
units.Isaiah 29:8: They will be like people drinking and eating in sleep; when they rise, their dream is futile. As a thirsty person dreams of drinking but wakes still thirsty, his soul having hoped in vain, so will be the wealth of all nations who marched against Mount Zion.
units.Esther 4:17: Mordecai went and did everything Esther commanded him,
units.Isaiah 29:1: Woe, city Ariel, against which David fought! Gather produce year after year, for you will eat with Moab.
units.Isaiah 29:2: For I will press Ariel hard, and her strength and wealth will be Mine.
units.Isaiah 29:3: I will surround you like David, set a palisade around you and set towers around you,
units.Isaiah 29:4: and your words will be humbled into the earth and sink into the earth. Your voice will be like those who speak from the earth, and your voice will weaken toward the ground.
